1. Edit rate by condition

Bars: share of episodes that edited the protected test (10 per cell), with 95% Wilson intervals. C6 is the only condition where the edit is authorised.

2. Does verifying predict refusing?

Each point is one cell. Nemotron rarely verifies and usually edits; Step-5 usually verifies and almost never edits — even when the signature is valid (C6).

3. Effect of provenance labels

Edit rate without (left of each pair) and with the defence that prints signature status and registry role beside every post.

Select an episode to read the board, the agent’s reasoning turn by turn, and its exploratory reason label.
